nav.importHint: Bring guests, reservations and rooms over from your previous system

page.title: Import data
page.description: Bring your guests, reservations and rooms over from your previous system: upload the Cloudbeds export or a spreadsheet, review it row by row and confirm.
page.forbidden: You don't have permission to import data
page.forbiddenHint: Ask the hotel owner for the “Import data from another system” permission.

reservations.label: Reservations
reservations.title: Import reservations
reservations.description: Upcoming and in-house, with category, room and what was already paid.

guests.label: Guests
guests.title: Import guests
guests.description: Profiles with ID document, contact details, nationality and birth date.

room_types.label: Categories
room_types.title: Import categories
room_types.description: Room types with capacity, room numbers and base price.

rooms.label: Rooms
rooms.title: Import rooms
rooms.description: Room numbers with their category, floor and beds.

cloudbeds.label: Cloudbeds export
cloudbeds.description: The file you download from Cloudbeds: we recognize its columns, its statuses and its multi-room reservations.

generic.label: Excel or CSV
generic.description: From another system, your own spreadsheet or Housetel's template.

cloudbeds.reservations: In Cloudbeds, open Reservations, filter the ones arriving from today on and the ones in house, and use Export (.xlsx). Include the reservation number, guest, dates, room type, room, rate plan, status, grand total and balance due.
cloudbeds.guests: In Cloudbeds, open Guests and use Export. If you have the ID document, nationality and birth date, include them: you need them for TRA and SIRE.
cloudbeds.room_types: For categories use the template: copy your Cloudbeds room types with their capacity, room numbers and base price. We also recognize Cloudbeds' English column titles.
cloudbeds.rooms: For rooms use the template: copy the number and room type of each Cloudbeds room. We also recognize Cloudbeds' English column titles.

start.title: New import
start.order: Suggested order: categories and rooms (if you haven't created them yet), then guests and reservations last.
start.presetStep: Where does the file come from?
start.sourcePlaceholder: E.g. front desk spreadsheet, Little Hotelier
start.sourceHint: If you import from the same system again, Housetel updates what it brought before instead of duplicating it.
start.privacy: We keep the file only to review and import it: its data is erased 30 days after it finishes (Habeas Data). No emails or messages are sent to guests.

upload.drop: Drop your CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file here
upload.release: Release the file to upload it
upload.limits: Up to 15 MB and 10,000 rows. The first row must hold the column titles.

errors.xls: .xls files (Excel 97-2003) can't be read: open it in Excel and save it as .xlsx or .csv.
errors.size: The file is larger than 15 MB: split it into several files.

history.title: Previous imports
history.emptyHint: Once you upload a file, its result and report stay here.

job.discardDescription: “{{name}}” and its review are deleted. Nothing was imported yet.
job.purged: The file's data was already erased (Habeas Data, 30 days after it finished): the results stay.

ledger.showingOnly: Showing only these rows; tap again to see them all

fields.external_id: Number or id in your system
fields.name: Name

fieldHints.external_id: Avoids duplicates: importing again updates instead of repeating.
fieldHints.full_name: When it comes in one column; otherwise use First name and Last name.
fieldHints.nationality: Country name, code (CO, COL) or demonym.
fieldHints.language: When missing, the guest's country language is used.
fieldHints.status: Confirmed, not confirmed, in house… Cancelled and checked-out ones are not imported.
fieldHints.nights: Used when there is no check-out date.
fieldHints.room_type: Next you choose which Housetel category each value is.
fieldHints.room_number: When present, that room is assigned.
fieldHints.rate_plan: When missing, the plan you choose is used.
fieldHints.total_amount: What the guest pays for the stay; that price is kept.
fieldHints.balance_due: What is still owed: when there is no paid column, it is worked out.
fieldHints.source: Booking.com, Expedia, direct… Kept in the reservation notes.
fieldHints.third_party_id: The reservation code at the OTA.
fieldHints.code: When missing, it is built from the name.

map.detected_one: We recognized {{count}} of the file's {{total}} columns. Check the rest and map what's missing.
map.detected_other: We recognized {{count}} of the file's {{total}} columns. Check the rest and map what's missing.
map.emptyColumn: Empty column in the first rows
map.unused_one: {{count}} column of the file is not imported
map.unused_other: {{count}} columns of the file are not imported
map.detectedAll_one: We recognized the file's only column. Check it goes to the right value.
map.detectedAll_other: We recognized all {{count}} columns of the file. Check each one goes to the right value.

values.roomTypesHint: Tell us which Housetel category each value is. Rows with unmapped values are not imported.
values.ratePlansHint: Each plan in the file must match a Housetel plan that includes the category.
values.none: Not mapped (those rows are not imported)
values.unassigned_one: {{count}} value not mapped: its rows will fail.
values.unassigned_other: {{count}} values not mapped: their rows will fail.

options.title: How to read the file
options.defaultPlanHint: Used when a row has no rate plan.
options.dateFormatHint: How numeric dates such as 05/10/2026 are written.
options.dateAmbiguous: Every date can be read as day/month or as month/day: we use day/month/year. If your system uses month/day, pick it here.
options.includesTaxHint: Turn it on when the file's total already includes VAT, as in Cloudbeds. Non-resident foreigners pay no lodging VAT.
options.onExistingHint: Applies to what you already brought over from {{source}}.

existing.updateHint: Fills in data, changes dates and records new payments.
existing.skipHint: Leaves what already exists in Housetel untouched.

options.sourceHint: Name of the previous system. Importing twice from the same system duplicates nothing.

review.caption: Review, row by row
review.errors_one: {{formatted}} row has errors and won't be imported. Fix it in the file or check the value mapping.
review.errors_other: {{formatted}} rows have errors and won't be imported. Fix them in the file or check the value mapping.

dryHint.reservations: Simulate first: Housetel tries every reservation against the real availability and rooms without saving anything. Nothing is overbooked.
dryHint.guests: Simulate first: you'll see which guests would be created and which already exist (same ID document or email).
dryHint.room_types: Simulate first: you'll see which categories would be created and which updated.
dryHint.rooms: Simulate first: you'll see which rooms would be created and which updated.

confirm.reservations: Reservations are created with source “Import” ({{source}}). What was paid is recorded as an “Imported balance” payment and in-house reservations are checked in. No emails or messages are sent to guests, and you can roll it back.
confirm.guests: New guests are created and existing ones with the same ID document or email are filled in. No emails are sent.
confirm.room_types: Categories are created or updated with their rooms; the base price is added to your rate plans.

review.noDryWarning: You haven't simulated it yet: rows without availability will fail (nothing is overbooked).

progress.label: Progress

hint.dry_run: Every row goes through the same services as the real import, without saving anything.
hint.run: Rows are saved one by one: if one fails, the rest go on.
hint.revert: Reservations nobody touched since the import are cancelled with no fee.

progress.stale: No progress from the server for a few minutes. You can relaunch it: it resumes where it stopped.
progress.leave: You can leave this page: the process keeps running on the server and you'll see it in the history.

result.caption: Result, row by row
result.failed: The import stopped before finishing. Rows already imported are not repeated when you resume it.
result.fixFailed_one: {{formatted}} row was not imported. Download the error report, fix it in your file and upload it again: what was already imported is skipped.
result.fixFailed_other: {{formatted}} rows were not imported. Download the error report, fix them in your file and upload it again: what was already imported is skipped.

revert.title: Roll back this import?
revert.description: Reservations created by this import that nobody touched since are cancelled with no fee, and their imported payments are voided. It stays in the audit log.
revert.loading: Working out what can be rolled back…
revert.inHouse_one: {{count}} is in house: not rolled back.
revert.inHouse_other: {{count}} are in house: not rolled back.
revert.activity_one: {{count}} has later activity (payments, charges or changes): not rolled back.
revert.activity_other: {{count}} have later activity (payments, charges or changes): not rolled back.

report.label: CSV report (opens in Excel)
report.issues: Only rows with errors or warnings
report.purged: The file's data was already erased: the report only has the results.
